description: The inputs Elab.elab (formal/Exegra/Elab.lean) refuses among the goldens (all version 2) and the version-2 fixtures under tests/, with the kind of each refusal (WG-5681, criterion 16); `undecoded` marks a fixture the format-2 decoder itself refuses (its distribution kinds are the JavaScript sampler's), which no engine runs. tests/core/formal-elab.test.js checks that exactly these are refused. The non-integer literals of fixture/expression-showcase before its edit (criterion 22 b) are refused as notInteger; the test checks that refusal on the pre-edit expressions.
